1783.note_text: 1. An electronic device may be a complete measuring instrument (e.g. counter scale, electricity meter) or a part of a measuring instrument (e.g. printer, indicator). 2. An electronic device may be a module in the sense this term is used in OIML B 3 OIML Certificate System for Measuring Instruments . 3. [OIML D 11:2004, 3.2]

1781.note_text: device employing sub-assemblies and performing a specific function. An electronic device is usually manufactured as a separate unit and is capable of being tested independently
